content: Yeisuw iya̱tal wamatan Paylat
Iyam-nen ga̱boug, illivans tasiyas tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek sisiyas tammwayas, idokes kadiloka beiweiys Yeisuw, beimat.
Naman iyawanis vatul waseg, itokes, inawes Paylat waseg, guma-Lom towen sigabman avakaein.
Yudas ikanig

Yudas, mtowen tasilkodein Yeisuw, ikakina beiweiys Yeisuw, ikanavin nanon, iyamen maysan towen, money silib sinawatoun, bisekes kid tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek sisiyas tammwayas, ilana, “Agusinap kalbaleb; bo asilkod gamag towen bwanabwein.” Iweis tasiyas, ilansa, “Ya̱koum muwotet; yakamey nag.”
Yudas ipiyev money towen, ilev in Yowbad wanbunatum wanuwan, inoun in, ikow vatul, iyawen kayon mo ikayagweg, imat.
Tasiyas gog tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek ikawes money towen, ilansa, “Towen maysan gamag buya̱vin, awoum binek Yowbad namuloul. Ama̱wan bitavkakes money towen?”
Mapuna iyamiyises tawtelein loutan napwepway, va̱gan kid bidibwanis takanigs asibwabwal igaw bikanka̱nigs ven towen waseg.
Peinan money towen maysan gamag buya̱vin, mapuna tadokes pwepway towen yagan “Gamag buya̱vin pwapwayein.” Tut towen waseg pwepway yagan ma̱wan.
Iva̱ges ma̱wan, mo ikamat liva̱nen palopit towen Yelemay, peinan kweiboug ilivnek mamagina:

content.text: “Ikawes money silib sinawatoun, maysan mtowen min-Yisleil bo ikaliwages, mo iyamiyises tawtelein loutan napwepway. DaGuyaws bo ikaliwageig ma̱wan.”

content: Inawes Yeisuw gabman waseg, itow wamatan. Mtowen gabman mo ikatigan, ilana, “Tabta ya̱koum min-Yudiy siking ya̱koum?” Iw to Yeisuw ilana, “Ma̱wan amlivan.”
Tanuwgwes lun situwa̱veks sisiyas tammwayas mo iyateles Yeisuw; towen gog nag ikatimop ikka̱pay-wan.
Iw to Paylat ilana, “Tab kwatiligen liva̱neim babaw illivans?”
Towen gog nag kweitan livan iyamen; mapuna gabman towen bo isunasun nanon.
Ikaleiwag va̱gan beiweiys Yeisuw
Bweilim katanok katanok sagal towen waseg, gabman ansinap bilik tasiwun deil, am-towen sivines tababaw gamag. E, bilik mo bein wamnat.
Teitan wa̱deil nises, butun avakaein peinan ansinap kalbaleb, yagan Yeisuw Bala̱bas.

Katikunouks gog gamag babaw, Paylat ikatugan, ilana, “Kal sivinamiy? Kwavtagis yagan mo balik bein wamnat. Tabta sivinamiy Yeisuw Bala̱bas? o adok sivinamiy Yeisuw, mtowen idokes Kelis? Takaleiwag yakamiy.”
Ikakin geg iyateles Yeisuw peinan ikamliwes.

Tage mtowen Paylat issin wakaban va̱gan bikaleiwag, Paylat nakwav mo ikayeb natouwat inek, isek aygan nakwav mamagina, “Awoum kuvag aveiyag taw towen waseg. Gamag towen bwanabwein. Boug akamikon towen silma̱nin; mapuna singay igeg nanoug.”
Bo itatays ninous gamag babaw, tasiyas tanuwgwes lun situwa̱veks sisiyas tammwayas; ilansa, “Kwavtagis Bala̱bas yagan; Yeisuw gog beimat.”
Vayuwein gabman towen ikatugan; ilana, “Asteiy wa̱deil nisesus. Am-towen sivinamiy balik beiw wamnat?” Ilansa, “Bala̱bas.”
“Tage aveiyag bavag waseg Yeisuw? Mtowen idokes Kelis.” Ilansa, “Kwatimet waklos.”
Iw to Paylat ilana, “Aveiyag wawun? Nag ivag ansinap kalbaleb.” Iweis tasiyas, iwkuwaks, ilansa, “Kwatimet waklos!”

Paylat go ikakin ta-ma̱wan binuwek, peinan kakita bisilamaws kawpwanaw; mapuna idow natouwat, ilana, “Soup kumey, bawid namag.” Imey, iwid naman wamtes gamag babaw, ilana, “Yey nag ba̱weiy gamag towen bwanabwein; e, takaleiwags yakamiy.”
Iweis tasiyas, ilansa, “Yakamey bakakaleiwag, baka̱weiy; mawotet towen mapun bakalivet simayas nitimayas.”
Paylat mo ilik Bala̱bas, inekes tasiyas. Ilivan gog Yeisuw beiweiys vatul waseg, bisekes asibabaw bikatimates waklos.
Takannaviys isiba̱wes Yeisuw

Gabman nagamag tasiyas takannaviys itokes Yeisuw inawes wasibunatum bunavakaein. Takannaviys asibabaw ikatuyouns nimeis, inibwis Yeisuw anakweim, ivaskoumis anakweim avakaein bwabwel. Ikous, mo ikawes vatul kulikoul mamagina doudiw, ikwanis isenas wakunun, magina anapay; nakaytuk isekes wanaka̱tay; mo ikululs wamatan, ilansa, “Kalin nuwem ya̱koum, min-Yudiys siguyaw ya̱koum!” Isiba̱wes igegayous.
Ikous, mo igusus won towen, ikawes nakaytuk iways wakunun.
Isiba̱wes ikous, mo inibwis maynawen kweim bwabwel, ivaskomis anakweim tatonen, itokes, inawes beiweiys waklos.
Iweiys Yeisuw waklos
Isekes Yeisuw anklos kaytan beikew, inounas. Wa̱ked mo ilivatus gum-Saylin yagan Saymon, ilansa, “Kukow anklos taw towen.”
E, Saymon ikokew Yeisuw anklos, inounas ineis koy yagan Golgot. (Takativin livan bein aga-Muyuw ‘Takanig busabwesan.’)
Bo isekes Yeisuw wayn son a̱lun beimoum, va̱gan mamayuy biyenom; ikamkwen, ipiyev.

Pwapwat ikatikavates wanaman o wakaken; ikayagweg waklos. Takanaviys tasiyas iyakousis wotet towen, mo ikaliwages anakweim, kalisiy bikawes, mamagina makava ilaves kweitan youd silma̱nin bikines kalisiy bikawes asikweim tatanok tatanok tasiyas.
Ikous, mo isinis, imtakavates.
Anklos wakunuwatan ileles nakalbaleb mamagina, “Mtowen Yeisuw, min-Yudiy siGuyaw.”
Siney tavveinaws asteiy iweiys waklos, teitan wanaka̱tay, tayuwein wankimaw.
Tasiyas gog inounas makadewen ked isiba̱wes, asilivan kalbaleb, ilansa, “Ya̱koum kudoki bukugulek Yowbad nabunatum, bukuwlulavaw gog yam kweitoun. Magat Yowbad Natun yak, kubus kum, kuymoveim.”

Ma̱wan-vak tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek, sisiyas takatimkakeins kaleiwag, sisiyas tammwayas iyages Yeisuw, ivtokes livan, ilansa, “Bo ikatinabwes gamag mwasanin, nag kadilok bikatinob tatonen.” E, ilansa, “Mtowen kid Yisleil guyawun, kadiloka beibus waklos beim, mo bitaliganes anilivan. Peinan anilivan, ‘Asimounid Tamag Yowbad waseg; yey Yowbad Natun yey.’ Magat Yowbad sivinan gamag towen, kadiloka beim bikatinob.”
Ma̱wan-vak tavveinaws tasiyas asteiy nikayagwegs wasklos, iyages Yeisuw.
Yeisuw ikanig
Ya̱nay idadub ven babaw ee... ka̱las itageg mo ikamnat vayuwein.
Igaw dadub ven, Yeisuw mo iwak, aygan avakaein, ilana, “Eli, Eli. Lamasabaktaniy.” (Takatavini go bein aga-Muyuw waseg: ‘Guna Yowbad! GunaYowbad! Aveiyag wawun nukulisaweig?’)
Gamag mwasanin nitatos wadadan iliganes, idokes Yeisuw ididow kid Ilaytiy.
Mapun teitan isawl in, ikow yotout isen wayn yayan wanuwan, ika̱lawt yotout, ibes wamatan kayal iyasel, isek Yeisuw, imoum.
Mwasinis gog ilivans, “Ga ises. Adok Ilaytiy beim bikatinob. Ga takines.”
Vayuwein Yeisuw mo iwak, aygan avakaein, kululuwan ilisow, bo ikanig.

Maynatan kweim nisilbwed palakakit, Yowbad wanbunatum, tut towen waseg mo iksigeb maynawen kweim; isilamaw wanakaew, iksigeb in watinow, ivag mwayney. Nik ivag, dakul itavis, alawag ikaliyowes, tadidumwals mwasinis nimmasis wakalugwes, tutan Yeisuw ikit vayuwein mo ikits tasiyas, inounas ineis Yelusalem, gamag babaw ikines.
Takalikay towen siney tasiyas takannaviys imtakavates Yeisuw, ikines nik, ikines youd siyas nikamats; aspwa̱yat, ilansa, “Mounid Yowbad natun.”

Vinay mwasinis itowas tanbes. Na̱tan vinen-Magdal yagan Meliy; nayuwein valeyin, mana̱wen nitun tasiyas Yemes son Yosep; natounun Sebediy nakwav, ivag nitsiyas tawaw asteiy; sisiyas vinay mwasanin. Tasiyas kweiboug sisiy Yeisuw meinoy Galiliy nimeis, o yam babaw imtakavates. E, tasiyas itowas tanbes ikakins.
Yeisuw itakus
Yeisuw inavamul guyaw teitan yagan Yosep. Inaven Alimatiy. Yam towen kwayav waseg inek Paylat, initoug kaleivin Yeisuw bidibwen. Paylat itam.

Yosep ikow kaleivin Yeisuw, isumweil kweim pwapwa̱kaw gimagim, isen wakalawag. Inakalawag takunumwan kweitan bo itateiys wanuwan dakul, bo imlavag Yosep alawagan tatonen. Isen kaleivin Yeisuw wanuwan, iyatipin dakul avakaein, ikatibwed wadon leg, mo inoun.
Vinay asteiy isiwas tanaban isinis ikikines, vinen-Magdal yagan Meliy son valeyin.

Yam towen ikatunags silma̱nin sagal. Iyam-nen mo sagal; tasiyas tanuwgwes lun situwa̱vek sisiyas tasiyas Palisiy mo ikatuyouns inekes Paylat, ilansa, “Tamwey, kanuw anilivan tayyaweid towen, igaw mwamov, ilana, ‘Yam kweitoun mo ba̱kit vayuwein.’

“Kadiloka kukwaleiwag gamag mwasanin bimtakavates alawagan kweitoun yam. Mata ge navamul bineis ivenos kaleivin, mo bidibakes gamag, bilansa, ‘Bo ikit vayuwein.’ Singay mo bikatimweisis yaweid, bikatidavis gamag babaw.”
Iw to Paylat, ilana, “Takaymateins alawag nisesus wasigeis yakamiy. Kuneis kuwteles ma̱wan beibwein.”
Ineis tasiyas; youd mamagina kaybas ikawes, ipakus wawadon leg; takannaviys isekes siwotet imtakavates alawag towen.
